documents.title: California Bankruptcy Exemptions and Title 11 Statutory Authorities
documents.scope_synopsis: Governs bankruptcy domicile rules under 11 U.S.C. § 522 and California's non-stacking election between its CCP § 704 and CCP § 703.140(b) exemption systems. Also covers federal bankruptcy chapter eligibility and means test authorities under 11 U.S.C. §§ 109, 707(b), 1182, and 1325.

documents.title: CACB Central Guide: Signature Requirements and Types of Signatures Allowed
documents.jurisdiction_scope: U.S. Bankruptcy Court, Central District of California
documents.scope_synopsis: Provides guidance from the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Central District of California on signature requirements under FRBP 9011 and LBR 9011-1, including allowable signature types, software-generated signatures, holographic signature retention duties, proofs of service, and Electronic Drop Box (EDB) submissions by unrepresented parties.

documents.title: The Central Guide Supplement to LBR 5005-4: CM/ECF Procedures
documents.jurisdiction_scope: U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Central District of California
documents.scope_synopsis: Supplements Local Bankruptcy Rule 5005-4 with procedures for Case Management/Electronic Case Filing (CM/ECF) in the Central District of California. Covers CM/ECF system overview and help desk support, attorney eligibility, registration, password and address management, effective filing dates, holographic signature requirements, formatting conventions, hyperlinks, and resumption of service.

documents.title: U.S. Bankruptcy Court Central District of California: Warning for Electronic Filers on Flattening PDF Files
documents.jurisdiction_scope: U.S. Bankruptcy Court, Central District of California
documents.scope_synopsis: Sets forth local electronic filing guidance from the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Central District of California regarding the requirement to flatten PDF files. Addresses technical submission warnings for electronic filers.

documents.title: CACB Local Bankruptcy Rules (LBR 1001-1 through 1073-1)
documents.scope_synopsis: Governs Local Bankruptcy Rules 1001-1 through 1073-1 covering rule scope and sanctions, required case commencement documents, petition filing fees and waivers, verification, and corporate relationship disclosures. Also addresses joint administration, substantive consolidation, case conversion, subsequent filings after dismissal, and assignment or reassignment of related cases and proceedings.

documents.title: CACB Local Bankruptcy Rules (LBR 3003-1 through 3022-2)
documents.jurisdiction_scope: U.S. Bankruptcy Court, Central District of California (CACB)
documents.scope_synopsis: Governs Central District of California Local Bankruptcy Rules 3003-1 through 3022-2, covering Chapter 11 claims bar dates, claim objections, and final decree/case administration standards. Includes extensive Chapter 13 case procedures under LBR 3015-1, such as self-employed debtor reporting, plan payments to the trustee, dismissal, fee disclosures, postconfirmation adequate protection orders, RARA elections, and motion service requirements.

documents.title: CACB Local Bankruptcy Rules 5003-2 through 5095-1
documents.scope_synopsis: This document contains Local Bankruptcy Rules (LBR 5003-2 through 5095-1) governing the removal of court records and files, document and mandatory electronic filing requirements, notice and recording exception rules, and the investment of estate funds.

documents.title: CACB Local Bankruptcy Rules (LBR 9001-1, 9009-1 through 9075-1)
documents.jurisdiction_scope: U.S. Bankruptcy Court, Central District of California (CACB)
documents.scope_synopsis: Governs U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Central District of California local rules spanning LBR 9001-1 and LBR 9009-1 through 9075-1, including definitions, debtor schedules and declarations, and judges' procedures. Details motion practice and contested matters, CM/ECF service and notice, continuances, mediation requests, oral testimony, pretrial proceedings, proposed and amended orders, and emergency or regular-notice hearing procedures.

documents.title: CACB Manual: Bankruptcy Filing Software (Using 3rd Party Software to File Petitions)
documents.jurisdiction_scope: U.S. Bankruptcy Court, Central District of California
documents.scope_synopsis: Provides procedural guidance from the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Central District of California on using third-party bankruptcy filing software to upload and file petitions and related documents, such as Chapter 13 plans. Also includes general CM/ECF filing references and court website navigation links.

documents.title: CACB Manual: Bankruptcy Case Opening
documents.jurisdiction_scope: U.S. Bankruptcy Court, Central District of California
documents.scope_synopsis: This U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Central District of California manual outlines required documents and official forms for opening a bankruptcy case, including certificates of credit counseling, Chapter 7 means test calculations, schedules, and related local bankruptcy rule forms and court resources.

documents.title: CACB Manual: PDF Documents and CM/ECF
documents.jurisdiction_scope: U.S. Bankruptcy Court, Central District of California
documents.scope_synopsis: Provides U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Central District of California technical guidance on preparing PDF documents for CM/ECF filing, including handling editable forms, Mac OS X Word export settings, removing audio/video or JavaScript, and combining PDF files. Also captures court portal navigation links to attorney compliance lists, bankruptcy resources, government mailing addresses, unclaimed funds search, and employment pages.

documents.title: U.S. Bankruptcy Court Eastern District of California Local Rules of Practice (Redlined, Effective April 2026)
documents.jurisdiction_scope: U.S. Bankruptcy Court, Eastern District of California
documents.scope_synopsis: Governs local bankruptcy practice and procedure in the Eastern District of California effective April 2026, covering filing and signature rules, Chapter 7 bifurcated fee agreements, estate funds, claim objections, discovery limitations, proof of service, evidentiary hearings, and selected general orders.

documents.title: CAEB Master Address List Instructions
documents.scope_synopsis: Governs e-filing file separation, physical formatting requirements, and party inclusion or exclusion rules for preparing and submitting a bankruptcy Master Address List and verification.

documents.title: U.S. Bankruptcy Court Instructions: Bankruptcy Forms for Individuals (Rev. April 2025)
documents.scope_synopsis: Provides U.S. Bankruptcy Court filing instructions and definitions for Official Bankruptcy Forms used by individual and joint debtors, including petition filing deadlines, nondischargeable debt considerations, and median income rules. Covers specific schedules and statements such as Schedules D and H, Summary of Assets and Liabilities (Form 106Sum), Current Monthly Income statements (including Form 122B and Chapter 13 forms), reaffirmation procedures, and claim classifications.

documents.title: Federal Diversity Jurisdiction Authorities (28 U.S.C. § 1332)
documents.scope_synopsis: Governs federal diversity jurisdiction requirements under 28 U.S.C. § 1332(a), including the $75,000 amount-in-controversy threshold and the complete diversity rule. Also covers federal precedent establishing the nerve center test for determining a corporation's principal place of business, including for holding and operating entities.

documents.title: Federal Diversity Jurisdiction Authorities
documents.scope_synopsis: Governs federal diversity of citizenship jurisdiction under 28 U.S.C. § 1332(a), including the $75,000 amount-in-controversy threshold and the complete diversity requirement. Also covers corporate citizenship and principal place of business determinations under the nerve center test, including its application to holding and operating entities.

documents.title: Official Form 101 - Voluntary Petition for Individuals Filing for Bankruptcy
documents.scope_synopsis: Provides the form fields for Official Form 101, the Voluntary Petition for Individuals Filing for Bankruptcy, capturing debtor identification details such as name, last four digits of SSN, street, and city/state.

documents.title: Official Form 106A/B - Schedule A/B: Property
documents.scope_synopsis: Provides the structured asset table for Official Form 106A/B (Schedule A/B: Property), containing Asset Rows 1 through 6 and the Total Assets AB summary field. Consult this document when referencing the tabular layout and line-item structure for reporting property assets on Schedule A/B.

documents.title: Official Form 106C - Schedule C: The Property You Claim as Exempt
documents.scope_synopsis: Provides the structured table layout for Official Bankruptcy Form 106C (Schedule C), capturing the selected exemption regime and itemized exemption rows for property claimed as exempt.

documents.title: Official Form 106D - Schedule D: Creditors Who Hold Claims Secured by Property
documents.scope_synopsis: Contains the tabular layout of Official Form 106D (Schedule D) for listing creditors who hold claims secured by property. Consult this document when inspecting the structure or secured claim rows of Schedule D.

documents.title: Official Form 106Dec - Declaration About an Individual Debtor's Schedules
documents.scope_synopsis: Contains Official Form 106Dec for an individual debtor's declaration about their schedules, including fields for Debtor1 Name, Declaration Date, and Debtor1 Signature.

documents.title: Official Form 106E/F - Schedule E/F: Creditors Who Have Unsecured Claims
documents.scope_synopsis: Contains the structured table layout for Official Form 106E/F (Schedule E/F: Creditors Who Have Unsecured Claims). It provides tabular rows for recording unsecured creditor claims.

documents.title: Official Form 106G - Schedule G: Executory Contracts and Unexpired Leases
documents.scope_synopsis: Provides the structured table template for Official Form 106G (Schedule G), used to itemize a debtor's executory contracts and unexpired leases across individual contract rows.

documents.title: Official Form 106H - Schedule H: Your Codebtors
documents.scope_synopsis: Provides the tabular structure for Official Form 106H (Schedule H: Your Codebtors), organized into sequential codebtor rows for recording codebtor information.

documents.title: Official Form 106I - Schedule I: Your Income
documents.scope_synopsis: Summary table for Official Form 106I (Schedule I: Your Income), organizing employer summary details and monthly income entries.

documents.title: Official Form 106J - Schedule J: Your Expenses
documents.scope_synopsis: Covers Official Form 106J (Schedule J: Your Expenses), including household size, itemized expense breakdowns, Schedule J monthly expenses, and monthly net income calculations.

documents.title: Official Form 106Sum - Summary of Your Assets and Liabilities
documents.scope_synopsis: Presents Official Form 106Sum summarizing a debtor's assets and liabilities. Covers fields for debtor name along with totals for assets (Schedule A/B) and secured, priority, and unsecured claims.

documents.title: Official Form 107 - Statement of Financial Affairs (SOFA)
documents.scope_synopsis: Provides the Official Form 107 Statement of Financial Affairs (SOFA) summary table, covering debtor income history and SOFA transaction summaries.

documents.title: Official Form 108 - Statement of Intention for Individuals Filing Under Chapter 7
documents.scope_synopsis: Provides the structured table representation of Official Form 108, the Statement of Intention for Individuals Filing Under Chapter 7, organizing entries across individual intention rows.

documents.title: Official Form 121 - Statement About Your Social Security Numbers
documents.scope_synopsis: Contains Official Form 121, a restricted private statement used to report a debtor's name, full Social Security number, and filing date.

documents.title: Official Form 122A-1 - Chapter 7 Statement of Your Current Monthly Income
documents.scope_synopsis: Covers Official Form 122A-1 rules and calculations for Chapter 7 bankruptcy cases, including the lookback window, Current Monthly Income (CMI), annualized CMI, and household determinations.

documents.title: CACB Local Form F 1007-1 - Verification of Master Mailing List of Creditors
documents.jurisdiction_scope: U.S. Bankruptcy Court, Central District of California (CACB)
documents.scope_synopsis: Provides the reference structure for CACB Local Form F 1007-1 governing the Verification of Master Mailing List of Creditors. It outlines required filing fields including debtor name, creditor matrix count, and attorney name.

documents.title: CACB Local Form F 5005-4 - Electronic Filing Declaration
documents.scope_synopsis: Provides CACB Local Form F 5005-4, the Electronic Filing Declaration, including fields for debtor name, attorney name, and attorney bar number.

documents.title: Executive Engineering Competency Rubric (REQ-ENG-402)
documents.scope_synopsis: Defines executive engineering job description competency rubrics and scoring criteria for requisition REQ-ENG-402. Covers cloud economics budget ownership and efficiency benchmarks, as well as minimum direct permanent FTE engineering organization scope requirements excluding dotted-line contractors.

documents.title: Executive Engineering Rubric
documents.scope_synopsis: Governs executive engineering qualification baselines and scoring criteria, including cloud economics (FinOps) ownership thresholds and minimum direct permanent FTE organization scope requirements.
